title: Employee Ticket Routes — Create / Edit
overviewHtml:
The route the employee's air tickets are priced on, for a period. Routes for the same employee cannot overlap.

The ticket provision and average ticket calculations take the fare for this route.

fields.label: StartDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Its dates cannot overlap another record for the same employee.
fields.html: What it is. The first day this record applies.

fields.label: EndDate
fields.rules: Required. Date value. Cannot be before the start date.
fields.html: What it is. The last day this record applies.

fields.label: TicketRouteId
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Ticket Route master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The route.

Example. Kuwait – Cairo

Why it matters. The ticket fare is looked up for this route; without a fare row for the route, the provision line is left unchanged.
fields.adminHtml: Maintained under Payroll Management → Ticket Routes, with fares under Payroll Management → Ticket Fares.
